## About
JAC is a mom and pop shop run by Justin and his wife Laurie. To them, it is not just a business, it is a family, and they want to give you and your family honest automotive care you can depend on.
Justin began his career sweeping the floors of the shop he runs today. He went on to become a Certified Technician, a Service Manager and a General Manager before he and Laurie decided to venture out on their own.
Your car gets you to work, to the grocery store and to school pickup. When you bring it to JAC, the goal is simple: it leaves trouble-free, so you keep your freedom and your peace of mind.

## Services
- Oil change and filter service: Routine oil and filter changes to keep your engine running well.
- General maintenance: Everyday maintenance for both foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Factory scheduled maintenance: The maintenance your manufacturer recommends, done at a local shop.
- Engine and transmission service: Service and repair for the parts that keep your car moving.
- Heating and air conditioning: Keep the cabin comfortable year round.
- Steering and suspension: Repairs for a smoother, steadier ride.
- Computerized diagnostics and repairs: Tracking down and fixing problems in your car's computer systems.

## FAQ
Q: Where exactly is the shop?
A: We are on Oak Grove Rd in Walnut Creek, located in the Snack Shop at the Valero Station.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We handle general maintenance on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: If I send a message through the website, when will I hear back?
A: If a reply is needed, you will hear back within 24 to 48 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
